1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农吃了以后，他没有病” / Formula: 谁 + 吃了 + 什么 + 以后，病 + 就 + 好了；or 谁 + 就 + 不生病了 / Correct: “神农吃了灵芝以后，病很快就好了。” “没有病” means “not ill” as a general state. Since he was sick before, “病好了” clearly expresses recovery.
